places.note_en: The largest licensed taxi company in Kelowna, with wheelchair-accessible taxis; call 250-762-2222 (West Kelowna side: 250-762-4444) or use its app. Taxis wait at the front curb of Kelowna airport (YLW), which helps when no bus is running.

places.alias: taxi cab Kelowna Cabs airport YLW wheelchair accessible taxi 出租车 打车 的士 叫车 机场 轮椅出租车
places.verify_notes: Phones (Kelowna 250.762.2222, Westside 250.762.4444, toll free 1.800.375.9848), office address 5-3312 Appaloosa Rd, Kelowna V1V 2W5, app and online reservation from https://www.kelownacabs.ca/contact-us and home page; home page says 'We have Wheelchair Accessible taxis, Senior and Student Discounts as well as Airport Service.' Hours are NOT stated on the company site, so hours_text left blank (no 24/7 claim). Address is the company office, not a taxi stand; g=nk from BC Geocoder coordinates (49.921, -119.394). PTB taxi licensee list (https://www.ptboard.bc.ca/taxi-licensee-list, updated September 2026): 'Kelowna Cabs (1981) Ltd.', Central Okanagan, 78 conventional + 14 accessible taxis (largest in the region). YLW airport page (https://ylw.kelowna.ca/passengers/transportation, City of Kelowna, read 2026-10-04) lists this company and phone under 'Taxi and limousine services' and says 'Wheelchair-accessible vehicles and taxis are available at the front curb at YLW' and that a 2-dollar fee applies on any airport taxi trip longer than three kilometres. Ride-hailing: the Passenger Transportation Board ride-hail licensee list (https://www.ptboard.bc.ca/ride-hail-licensee-list, updated September 2026) shows Uber (regions 1-5), URide (2-5), Coastal Rides (1-5) and Safe Ride Sharing (4) approved for Region 4, which includes Central Okanagan (region table on https://www.ptboard.bc.ca/ride-hail-rates). The BC government Passenger Transportation Registry (https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/transportation/vehicle-safety-enforcement/services/passenger-transportation/guidance-resources/passenger-transportation-registry, updated 2026-09-23) lists 'Actual Ride-Hail Operating Areas' that include Kelowna only for Uber and Uride (Uride also Lake Country); Coastal Rides does not list Kelowna and Safe Ride Sharing is 'N/A - not currently operating'. West Kelowna is not named for any ride-hail company. The registry warns approved companies 'may operate only in select areas'. The YLW airport page says 'Ride share is now available at YLW' (Uber, Uride), pickup at the north end of the terminal outside Arrivals.

places.n: Central Okanagan Public Schools (SD23) – Transportation Services (school bus office)
places.hours_text: Mon. to Fri. 6:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. (SEP - JUNE)
places.who: Students attending their English catchment school who live 3 km or more (elementary), 4 km or more (middle) or 4.8 km or more (high school) from it. Students closer than that are 'courtesy riders' and get a seat only if space is available. No service for students living less than 2 km from their English catchment school, or attending a school of choice outside their catchment. Only registered riders may ride.
places.cost: fee per student per school year (lower for the third and fourth child; no additional cost for a fifth child or more; pro-rated by months). Fee subsidy available for financial hardship.
places.note_en: Your child can ride the school bus only after you apply online at busconnect.sd23.bc.ca and they are assigned to a route; applications sent after May 31 go on a waitlist. Eligible students live at least 3 km (elementary), 4 km (middle) or 4.8 km (high school) from their English catchment school, a yearly fee applies, and families in financial hardship can apply for a subsidy.
places.note_zh: 孩子必须先在 busconnect.sd23.bc.ca 网上申请并被分配到线路后才能坐校车；5 月 31 日之后提交的申请会进入候补名单。符合资格的学生住处离其英语学区学校至少 3 公里（小学）、4 公里（初中）或 4.8 公里（高中）；校车按年收费，经济困难的家庭可申请费用减免。
places.alias: school bus SD23 transportation bus registration busconnect courtesy rider catchment 校车 校车申请 学区 交通 接送 上学
places.verify_notes: Checked 2026-10-04 on SD23 official pages. (1) https://www.sd23.bc.ca/transportation-services-programsservices: 76 school bus routes serving Lake Country, Kelowna, West Kelowna and Peachland; 'Parents are required to submit the online transportation application'; 'A student must be registered on a route to ride the school bus'; 2026-2027 timeline: applications for eligible students between Feb 2 and May 31, 2026 processed in order; 'Applications received after May 31 will not be processed until August or later and students will be placed on a waitlist'; office accepts applications throughout the school year; students get a bus pass that must be scanned; no guest passengers; phone 250-870-5151, transportation@sd23.bc.ca; 'Click Here' to apply links to https://busconnect.sd23.bc.ca (Registration Connect portal, 2026-2027 option shown). (2) Contact page https://www.sd23.bc.ca/contact.aspx (redirect from /ProgramsServices/transportation/Pages/Contact.aspx): 'Transportation Offices are located at: 685 Dease Road, Kelowna ... V1X 4A4', office hours 'Mon. to Fri. 6:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. (SEP - JUNE)'. (3) Eligibility https://www.sd23.bc.ca/eligibility (Policy 470R): distances 3 km / 4 km / 4.8 km from English catchment school; courtesy riders seated only if space (elementary first, then middle, then secondary); special-needs transport approved by Student Support Services is prioritized; no service under 2 km or for school of choice outside catchment; catchment maps linked. (4) Fees https://www.sd23.bc.ca/transportation-fees-payments-transportation: 2026-2027 annual fee per student (first and second child same amount, third and fourth half; no additional cost for five or more; family cap stated), charged to School Cash Online, pay in full or monthly within 30 days; cash/cheque in person at School Board Office 1040 Hollywood Road South; subsidy via school principal (exceptional circumstances) or CRA proof of income to subsidy@sd23.bc.ca. (5) Delays/cancellations are posted on the 'School Bus Stop' site; parents must subscribe for text/email alerts (https://www.sd23.bc.ca/school-bus-stop-). g=rt from BC Geocoder (685 Dease Rd at 49.898, -119.408, near Ben Lee Park). Office hours outside Sep-June are not stated.

places.n: Kids Care Spray/Water Park (Westbank Centre Park)
places.who: Children and families (public park; the park is wheelchair accessible)
places.note_en: A spray park in West Kelowna, in Westbank Centre Park next to Julia's Junction, an inclusive playground for all abilities; it runs from around the May long weekend to early September. Flush toilets and change rooms are open while the spray park operates, and parking is free.
places.note_zh: West Kelowna 的一处喷水乐园，位于 Westbank Centre Park，旁边是适合各种能力儿童的无障碍游乐场 Julia's Junction；大约每年 5 月长周末开放到 9 月初。喷水乐园开放期间有冲水厕所和更衣室，停车免费。
places.alias: spray park splash pad water park Kids Care Westbank Centre Park Julia's Junction West Kelowna 喷水池 戏水 水上乐园 儿童 西基洛纳 无障碍游乐场
places.verify_notes: City of West Kelowna Parks and Facilities finder detail page (source_url; read 2026-10-04 in a browser): 'Westbank Centre Park - Julia's Junction and the Kids Care Spray/Water Park', 2569 May St, West Kelowna, BC V4T 0G7, Tel (778) 797-8849 (appears to be the general parks line used on most park listings). Text: 'Spray park CLOSED for the season'; 'Kids Care Spray/Water Park (dawn to dusk) -CLOSED FOR THE SEASON The spray park opens for the summer season each year around May long weekend and closes early September'; 'Flush toilets and change rooms are available for public use while the spray park is in operation'; 'The park is wheelchair accessible'; amenities include Free Parking and Washrooms. Julia's Junction page https://www.westkelownacity.ca/parks-recreation-facilities/parks/julias-junction-inclusive-play-space/ says it is 'next to the Kids Care Spray/Water Park'. Searching the finder for 'Spray' returns only this park, so it is the only City of West Kelowna spray park listed. The older facility URL (facilities.westkelownacity.ca/Home/Detail?Id=99664498-...) now redirects to a 404 after the City's new website launch. Cost: not stated on the current page; an older City news release that described it as free to use has been removed, so cost left blank. Older third-party-visible text quoting 9:30 a.m.-7:30 p.m. hours is superseded by the current 'dawn to dusk'. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (second reader): wording tightened.

places.who: Adults and teens. No children under 10; ages 10-11 must be supervised by a parent or guardian at all times; ages 12-16 must complete an orientation to use the fitness centre on their own. No child/youth programs or child minding at this location.

places.note_en: Downtown YMCA fitness centre with weights, cardio machines, a cycle studio and group classes such as yoga; you can drop in without a membership. Adults 19 and over must show photo ID, and children under 10 should not be brought here (the Family Y in Rutland has children's programs).
